nameJa: オプティカル・サンセリフ
conceptNote: 開いたカウンターと整えた字間のサンセリフ。白い余白と細い朱色のルールを使い、左上の文字と右下の小さな機能図に明快な階層を作る。
prompt:
Create a single image1760pixels wide by1120pixels tall, aspect11:7, compact landscape artprint. One finished Chrome Web Store promotional tile, not a mockup or a contact sheet.
Art direction01: optical neo-grotesk typography and rigorous editorial white space. Ivory-white background, precise ink-black lettering, restrained vermilion-red rules. The whole design is FLAT two-dimensional typography, exquisitely typeset, no materials simulation.
EXACT VISIBLE COPY each phrase once only: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Preserve exact capitalization. Fullscreen is ONE word. No extra words, letters, numbers, labels or tagline.
Typography is the main artwork: elegant regular-to-medium weight optical neo-grotesk with open counters, finely judged kerning, graceful curves and excellent proportions. Think refined contemporary Swiss culture publication, NOT Arial Black, NOT heavy bold, NOT condensed. The letterforms must feel airy, deliberate, and highly legible. No bevel, extrusion, embossing, shadow, texture or outline on any letter.
Layout: a strong upper-left aligned hierarchy. "YouTube" is a confident small first line, but still genuinely large: at least80pixel capital height on this artwork, never a tiny brand tag. Below it, "Fullscreen" in a much larger medium weight, then "Live Chat" in the same graceful size, with careful leading and no crowded lines. All text within an8% safe margin. Leave generous empty space below and to the right; the words must remain clear at220x140.
Secondary diagram in lower-right: one clean horizontal16:9video rectangle in a thin ink line, with4tiny fullscreen corner brackets, a modest black playtriangle on theleft and a vermilion chat speech-bubble on theright FULLY INSIDE that same frame. Chat bubble has just three short white horizontal strokes, no text or avatars. Small, sophisticated and balanced, never competing with the lettering. Add at most two short fine red editorial rules to structure negative space.
Palette warm-white, ink-black and vermilion only. Crisp print-like precision and optical alignment, yet no paper texture. No people, scenes, photo, interface, browser, fake messages, names, glass, 3D, plastic, shadows, gradients, neon, glowing edges, heavy chunky type, ultra-condensedtype, doodles, random decorations or watermark. Compact11:7canvas, every word and symbol entirely visible.

revisions.reason: Initial generated source was panoramic; request compact11:7canvas with finer regular-weight lettering.
revisions.prompt:
Image dimensions: 1760 x 1120 pixels. Aspect ratio: 11:7. A compact landscape postcard.
Recompose the supplied typography design into the requested compact 11:7 canvas, retaining the ivory, black, red visual identity and upper-left hierarchy.
The new composition must have significantly more height: three typographic lines at upper-left, then a small diagram at lower-right with extensive white space around it. All content inside 8% safe margins.
Exact text each once only: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Fullscreen is one word. YouTube remains clearly readable and at least 80 pixel capital height. The lettering should be a beautifully proportioned neo-grotesk in REGULAR weight, with the hairline-to-mainstem optical quality of finely printed contemporary type, not the bold default sans of the reference. Use open counters and precise kerning, no chunkiness, no condensed characters. Do not thicken the letters.
Keep one fine red editorial rule. The little black video outline at lower-right has a play triangle and small red chat bubble entirely inside it, three tiny white message strokes, four modest fullscreen corners. This flat diagram occupies no more than one quarter of the tile. Words dominate the composition.
Flat ink-on-white visual design, no visible texture, no shadows, no extrusion, no bevel, no material rendering, no extra copy, no labels, no background scene. All letters and graphic fully visible in a compact 11:7 postcard shape.

headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
